transcript_previews.content:
I searched Polymarket a couple of ways and didn't turn up any active Ethereum ETF markets right now.

- `resolve_polymarket_trade_intent` for "Ethereum ETF markets", "Ethereum ETF approval inflows price", and "ETH ETF staking spot" all returned zero candidates
- A broader scan of the active crypto tag (top 100 by volume) didn't surface any ETH-ETF-themed questions either

Context worth flagging: s...specific issuer questions — don't appear to have an open market on Polymarket today.

If you want, I can:
- Search a related angle (e.g., "ETH price end of year", "Solana ETF", "spot crypto ETF approvals")
- Pull the full crypto tag list (closed + active) so you can see resolved ETH ETF markets for reference
- Re-run with a specific phrase you have in mind

Just say the word — no orders staged.
